video_title: Unpacking Giannis Antetokounmpo trade between Heat and Bucks from all angles | NBA on NBC

quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro's role and future contract status with the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: Tyler Herro is 26 and one of the best offensive guards in the league.
quotes.quote: Tyler Herro is 26 and one of the best offensive guards in the league. He is from Milwaukee, so this is something of a homecoming for him from the Milwaukee area, I guess. For as long as he sticks around. Herro is in the final year of his contract and he will be expecting a new deal some point in the near future. The Bucks may look to flip him for more assets as they continue this rebuild.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaime Jaquez Jr.'s potential as a franchise point guard
quotes.excerpt: Great potential, I think, as a franchise point guard. I do think there's that potential there.
quotes.quote: I really like Jaime Jaquez Jr. He was a flashy playmaker at Illinois, good size, reminds me in some ways of a young Ricky Rubio. Played 53 games for the Heat last season, averaged 18 minutes. Great potential, I think, as a franchise point guard. I do think there's that potential there.

quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks' strategy to manage Andrew Wiggins and Norman Powell contracts
quotes.excerpt: They do need to work something out with Andrew Wiggins, maybe get him to opt out.
quotes.quote: They still have Bam Adebayo who was the one untouchable on that roster. They do need to work something out with Andrew Wiggins, maybe get him to opt out of his contract and do a longer deal at a lower cap number, and have to find a way to use that money to bring back Norman Powell. Without those subsequent deals, this trade is not going to mean a heck of a lot.

quotes.summary_phrase: Historical risks of teams going all-in for one or two players
quotes.excerpt: The history of teams that go all in for one player or two players is pretty checkered.
quotes.quote: The history of teams that go all in for one player or two players is pretty checkered. Brooklyn went all in for Paul Pierce and Kevin Garnett more than a decade ago. That wound up setting up Boston for its future, for the foundation of its future. The Clippers, they gave Oklahoma City the foundation of its championship team, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and all the draft picks they gave up to go get Paul George.

quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' disciplined approach in trade negotiations for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: They were willing to part with Jaylen Brown. They were willing to part with a couple of draft picks.
quotes.quote: The Celtics, they were very disciplined in this. They were willing to part with Jaylen Brown. They were willing to part with a couple of draft picks. And that was really it. They were not willing to gut the team of its young players, of its picks, of its swaps. My understanding is that the Celtics would have gone a little deeper into its cache of assets to finalize a deal, to get it done, but it just wasn't going to be enough for Milwaukee, which just wanted the kind of deep package that Miami was willing to offer.

quotes.summary_phrase: Potential damage to the Celtics' relationship with Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: How much damage has been done to their relationship with Jaylen Brown? This is a big one.
quotes.quote: How much damage has been done to their relationship with Jaylen Brown? This is a big one. Because this all kind of got out. I don't think the Celtics wanted it out there that they were this aggressive in their pursuit of Giannis Antetokounmpo just in case something like this happened, so they could have maybe some plausible deniability about how hard they were going after Giannis and how real a Jaylen Brown trade was. But it was real.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's history of being included in trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: He has been in trade talks, whether it's for Anthony Davis, Kawhi Leonard, in 2022 it was Kevin Durant.
quotes.quote: You go back really since Jaylen Brown's first or second year, he has been in trade talks, whether it's for Anthony Davis, Kawhi Leonard, in 2022 it was Kevin Durant, and now in 2026 it's Giannis Antetokounmpo. These trade talks over the years, most recently the last two, have really rubbed Jaylen Brown the wrong way. 2022 when they were talking about him for Kevin Durant, that was after Brown was part of the team that went to the finals.
